skill.name: ecommerce-product-comparison
skill.description: 当用户需要对比已选商品、比较规格和卖点差异，或准备竞品对照表时使用。输入 2–5 个商品链接或商品资料，输出注明价格口径、信息缺口和来源的商品差异表。在线商品能力支持抖音与小红书，其他平台可基于用户提供的资料分析。来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Compare two to five products in a table that shows specs, price conditions, sources, and missing information.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Seven findings reflect instructions to run an unpinned npm package or let it access service credentials; the other 26 are false positives. The online workflow also lacks safe shell argument handling and explicit approval for sharing lookup inputs or spending credits. No evidence of embedded malware, credential theft, or prompt injection was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Authentication and lookup run an unpinned npm package
remediation.suggestion: Use an approved, integrity-verified CLI release. Remove automatic downloads from the workflow and obtain approval before installing or updating the CLI.

remediation.issue: Product inputs may be inserted into shell commands
remediation.suggestion: Pass validated product identifiers and supported-platform URLs as separate arguments without shell evaluation. Prefer typed tool calls where available.

remediation.issue: The CLI can read credentials from its environment or a persistent file
remediation.suggestion: Pass only the scoped service credential to the approved CLI. Prefer a secret store and verify file permissions where local persistence is unavoidable.

remediation.issue: Online lookups can share product inputs and consume service credits
remediation.suggestion: Explain what inputs will be sent and that credits may be used. Obtain approval for the lookup and any retry that could consume more credits.

content.value_statement: Product listings often use different pack sizes and price terms, making direct comparisons difficult. Compare selected products in one table with sources, price conditions, and missing details.
actual_capabilities: Compare two to five selected products using supplied specs, prices, and listing details.
Look up Douyin and Xiaohongshu product details by supported identifier or URL through an authenticated SocialDataX connection.
Separate variant prices, coupon prices, promotional prices, and price ranges.
Calculate unit prices when package quantities and units are clear and comparable.
Create a Markdown table with source links or IDs, observation times, and missing fields.
Distinguish seller claims from independent evidence and summarize which options suit stated needs.
limitations: Online lookup supports only Douyin and Xiaohongshu. For other platforms, provide listing details rather than links alone.
The skill compares selected products. It does not search categories or choose competitors.
It does not retrieve product reviews or infer sales, growth, or market share. Profit estimates require supplied costs and fees.
Online lookups require SocialDataX authentication and can use account credits. The CLI also requires Node.js and npm.

use_cases.title: Compare Pack Prices
use_cases.description: Compare selected offers by quantity, price conditions, and unit price before choosing a product.

use_cases.title: Review Competitor Listings
use_cases.description: Compare visible specifications and selling points across selected listings. Keep each seller claim separate from verified evidence.

use_cases.title: Build a Sourced Product Brief
use_cases.description: Organize selected listings by platform, source, observation time, and missing fields for a research brief.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Products
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with two sets of listing details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these two products using only the details I provide: [product details]. List the price, pack size, and missing information.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Unit Prices
prompt_templates.scenario: Review bundles with different quantities or discounts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these three offers from my notes: [offer details]. Separate coupon prices from regular prices. Calculate unit prices only where quantities and units are comparable.

prompt_templates.title: Check Selected Platform Listings
prompt_templates.scenario: Retrieve details for selected Douyin or Xiaohongshu products.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these Douyin and Xiaohongshu listings: [product links]. Confirm before using SocialDataX. Then record each source, observation time, price conditions, and missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Competitor Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare several variants across supplied sources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these five listings using the supplied evidence: [listing details]. Separate variants, temporary prices, and seller claims. Identify gaps that prevent ranking and list what to verify next.

output_examples.input: Compare supplied offers: Product A has 12 bottles for $18. Product B has 6 bottles of the same size for $10.
output: Product A: 12 bottles at $1.50 per bottle.
Product B: 6 bottles at about $1.67 per bottle.
Product A has the lower unit price. Source: supplied offer details. Shipping costs were not provided.

output_examples.input: Compare supplied listings: Product C is 500 mL at $9 with a coupon. Product D is $8, but the listing gives no volume.
output: Product C: 500 mL. The $9 price requires a coupon.
Product D: $8. Package volume and price conditions were not provided.
A unit price ranking is not supported. Verify Product D's volume and price conditions before comparing.

best_practices: Provide two to five listings and name the differences that matter to you.
Record the product variant, quantity, currency, and price conditions before comparing costs.
Use supplied details when possible. Confirm what will be sent and whether credits may be used before requesting online lookup.
anti_patterns: Do not rank products by unit price when quantities or units are missing or incompatible.
Do not treat seller claims, unrelated post comments, or missing fields as evidence of product quality.
Do not paste API keys into prompts or comparison reports.

faq.question: How many products can I compare?
faq.answer: Provide two to five selected products. Include listing details, supported product links, or supported platform identifiers.

faq.question: Which platforms support online lookup?
faq.answer: Online lookups support Douyin product IDs and Xiaohongshu SKU IDs, plus product links from either platform.

faq.question: Can I compare products from other platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste the relevant listing text or provide a table. Links alone are not enough for unsupported platforms.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or service credits?
faq.answer: Not for supplied data. Online lookup needs an authenticated SocialDataX connection and may consume service credits. Never share an API key in chat.

faq.question: How does the skill handle coupons and variants?
faq.answer: The table lists separate prices and their conditions. Unit prices are calculated only when sizes and quantities allow a fair comparison.

faq.question: Can the skill identify the best product?
faq.answer: It can compare options against your stated needs when evidence is sufficient. It flags gaps instead of forcing a ranking.
